meta.storyTitle: Move new-chat out of the history dropdown into an icon button left of the history widget
meta.triageRationale: One webview module, one obvious approach: the history menu trailing new… row is removed and a dedicated button is placed before .histchip, reusing the .pico icon slot and the existing newChatPick() message; the host new-chat contract is untouched. Two files change: chat-panel.ts and chat-panel.test.ts.

override.reason: User approved with override in chat: review stopped at paused attempt 2 (final-consistency retries exhausted, user declined resume and chose to present the LLD as-is). Attempt 1 MED findings were corrected and re-emitted as revision 2 through design.story; attempt 2 passed test-coverage and migration/alternatives.

summary.prose: This story moves the chat panel's new-chat action out of the history dropdown menu and into a dedicated icon button sitting immediately left of the history widget in the chrome bar. The button carries a chat-bubble-with-plus glyph and posts the exact same new-chat message as before, so session creation and all host-side handling are untouched; only the webview trigger and its pinning tests change.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

boundary.internal: Move new-chat out of the history dropdown into an icon button left of the history widget

contractDetails.surfaceLevel: VS Code chat webview shell (vscode-plugin/src/chat/chat-panel.ts): the .chrome header's right-aligned cluster (.right > #insrc-newchat button + .histchip > #insrc-history + #insrc-histmenu popup) [[c2]]. The history menu becomes a pure session list; new-chat is a first-class chrome button. No change to the host message protocol, the session store, or provider adapters.

api.name: renderHistoryMenu
api.signature: () => void — rebuilds #insrc-histmenu rows from histEntries (webview bootstrap function in the nonce'd shell script)
api.returns: void (mutates #insrc-histmenu children: one mitem row per histEntries entry, no trailing row)
errors: none — DOM-only; an empty histEntries yields an empty menu
preconditions: histMenu element exists in the shell
postconditions: #insrc-histmenu contains exactly one role=menuitem row per persisted chat and NO 'new…' row (the row this story removes)

api.name: newChatPick
api.signature: newChatPick(trigger: HTMLElement | null) => void — closes popups, refocuses trigger, posts the new-chat message (webview bootstrap function)

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.purpose: element to refocus after posting (the #insrc-newchat button)

postconditions: posts {v:1, payload:{type:'new-chat', provider: curProv || ''}} — identical payload to the old menu row, so the host's new-chat handler is unchanged

api.name: #insrc-newchat click listener
api.signature: (click on the chrome button) => stopPropagation(); newChatPick(nc) — new wiring added by this story

parameters.name: event
parameters.purpose: stopPropagation so document click-close does not race the post

errors: none — native <button> also fires click on Enter/Space, giving keyboard activation without extra handlers
preconditions: #insrc-newchat exists in the shell markup, placed before .histchip in .right [[c2]], with the shared .pico 14px icon slot for its SVG [[c4]]
postconditions: popups closed, new-chat posted, button keeps focus

dataModelChanges.details: No persisted or protocol change: the new-chat payload {type:'new-chat', provider} is byte-identical, history-list is unchanged, and no store schema is touched. The only data change is presentational: the history menu's row set loses its synthetic 'new…' entry.

errorCases.scenario: User clicks #insrc-newchat while a history/active popup is open
errorCases.detection: the button's own click listener stopPropagation()s before document click-close runs; newChatPick then calls closePops() itself
errorCases.response: all popups close, new-chat is posted once, focus moves to the button
errorCases.userImpact: none — single new-chat post, no double-fire

errorCases.scenario: Host rejects the new-chat (e.g. cross-provider new-chat on a started session)
errorCases.detection: the host’s new-chat provider-rejection branch calls only postRunConfig (chat-panel.ts:3309-3313), so the webview receives a ‘run-config’ message; that handler (chat-panel.ts:2693) re-syncs the curProv/run-button labels but does not call reconcile() — reconcile() fires only from ‘history-list’ (chat-panel.ts:2698, the rejected open-chat path) and ‘session-restored’
errorCases.response: webview state unchanged — the click never wrote to the trigger selections, so there is nothing to snap back; no menu row involved anymore
errorCases.userImpact: same as before the change — the refusal path is host-side and untouched

edgeCases.input: empty history list (no persisted chats yet)
edgeCases.expected: history menu opens with zero rows (no 'new…' row anymore); the #insrc-newchat button remains the only new-chat affordance and works identically

edgeCases.input: keyboard user focuses #insrc-newchat and presses Enter/Space
edgeCases.expected: native <button> fires click -> newChatPick(nc) posts new-chat; no custom key handler needed
document keydown closes popups (closePops); button is not a popup trigger, nothing else happens

inline SVG in static shell markup is allowed under the webview CSP (default-src ‘none’; style-src ‘unsafe-inline’ — the shell already carries a static inline SVG at chat-panel.ts:2782); the icon renders with currentColor

invariantsToPreserve.text: The new-chat message payload {type:'new-chat', provider: curProv||''} is unchanged, so the host's session-creation handler and all env('new-chat') host tests keep passing.
The history trigger’s empty label stays ‘new…’ (renderTriggers, chat-panel.ts:2561) — only the MENU row is removed, not the chip label.
closePops() still closes every popup and clears aria-expanded on both triggers; the new button needs no popup state.

migration.stateBefore: The chat chrome's .right cluster contains only the .histchip history widget; its dropdown menu (#insrc-histmenu) ends with a synthetic 'new…' / 'starts a new chat' row that posts {type:'new-chat'} via newChatPick (chat-panel.ts:2568). No dedicated new-chat button exists in the chrome.
migration.stateAfter: The history menu lists only persisted chats (no 'new…' row), and a dedicated icon button #insrc-newchat sits immediately left of .histchip in .right, carrying a chat-bubble-plus inline SVG and posting the identical {type:'new-chat', provider: curProv||''} message on click (native button keyboard semantics). Host, store and message protocol unchanged.

migrationSteps.action: Add the #insrc-newchat button markup before .histchip in .chrome .right with the bubble-plus SVG in a .pico slot, plus .newchatbtn CSS (chip-matching ground/border/radius, hover/focus-visible states)
Wire the button's click listener (stopPropagation + newChatPick(nc)) in the bootstrap script and remove the trailing mitem row from renderHistoryMenu
Update the two pinning tests in chat-panel.test.ts (history-trigger regression test, histchip markup test) and add assertions for the button placement, icon, wiring and the row-less menu

migration.backwardCompat: Fully backward compatible: the new-chat webview->host message payload is byte-identical, history-list is unchanged, no persisted schema exists for the chrome, and all host-side env('new-chat') tests pass unmodified. Older webview shells are not persisted (the shell is rebuilt on every panel open), so there is no mixed-version state.

alternativesConsidered.name: Icon button left of the history chip (chosen shape)
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: A real <button id=insrc-newchat> in .chrome .right immediately before .histchip; click posts the unchanged {type:'new-chat'} via newChatPick; the history menu loses its trailing new… row.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Markup: insert the button into the .right span before the histchip (chat-panel.ts:2751) [[c2]]. CSS: a compact bordered icon button reusing the chip's ground/border/radius and the existing .pico 14px slot [[c4]] for a bubble-plus inline SVG (currentColor). JS: const nc=getElementById('insrc-newchat'); nc click -> stopPropagation + newChatPick(nc); renderHistoryMenu drops the appended mitem row. Native <button> gives Enter/Space activation and focus for free; aria-label/title 'new chat'.
pros: Matches the requested UX exactly (button left of the history widget, bubble-plus icon)
Message contract {type:'new-chat'} and all host handling unchanged — zero host-side diff
Reuses existing primitives (.pico slot, .histchip look, newChatPick, closePops)
Keyboard accessible via native button semantics
Smallest diff that fully meets the story
cons: One more control in the chrome row (space is ample — .right is right-aligned with the actchip on the left)
